children: Equity proceeds will support AI software commercialization, enterprise project delivery and working capital
KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia, Nov. 25, 2026
-- Sagtec Global Limited

(“Sagtec” or the “Company”), a provider of AI-assisted software, enterprise technology and cloud-based digital solutions, today announced that it has received the full US$552,500 subscription payment from His Royal Highness Tengku Hassanal Ibrahim Alam Shah Ibni Al-Sultan Abdullah (“HRH The Crown Prince of Pahang, Malaysia”) in connection with its previously announced private placement.

The payment relates to the subscription for 850,000 Class A ordinary shares under the definitive private subscription agreement announced on September 18, 2026. The full payment provides Sagtec with additional equity capital to fund its business priorities without incurring interest or scheduled principal repayments through the transaction.
Greater Flexibility to Fund Enterprise Project Delivery

Sagtec intends to use a portion of the proceeds for working capital and enterprise project implementation. Customer deployments can require resources for software integration, configuration, testing and training before projects are fully operational. The additional funding gives Sagtec greater flexibility to cover these costs and assign technical and project management resources as customer projects progress.

The Company expects this flexibility to help it manage overlapping implementation schedules and pursue larger enterprise opportunities that require more extensive integration and ongoing support. Allocation of the proceeds will depend on customer demand, project schedules and operating requirements.
Bringing AI-Assisted Software to More Customers

Sagtec also intends to use the proceeds to support the commercialization of its AI-assisted software and enterprise technology platforms. Planned activities include adapting solutions to customer workflows, supporting product demonstrations and onboarding customers as deployments begin.

The Company sees opportunities to introduce AI-assisted functionality to businesses already using its enterprise software and smart ordering solutions. Sagtec also intends to support business development and customer acquisition in Malaysia and selected Southeast Asian markets, with spending guided by customer demand and the resources needed to deliver each project.
Building Opportunities for Recurring Revenue

The proceeds are also expected to support the cloud, database and server infrastructure behind Sagtec’s enterprise solutions. This infrastructure helps the Company host and maintain customer applications, manage data and provide technical support after deployment.

Sagtec sees opportunities to deepen customer relationships by offering subscriptions, cloud services, system maintenance and managed technical services alongside software implementation. Where customers adopt these services, Sagtec can continue generating revenue from the relationship after the initial project is delivered. Expanding these offerings is part of the Company’s strategy to grow recurring revenue alongside project-based sales.

“We appreciate His Royal Highness Prince Hassanal’s investment in Sagtec,” said Ng Chen Lok, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Sagtec Global Limited. “Receiving the full proceeds gives us more flexibility to fund customer implementations and bring our AI-assisted software to more businesses. Our focus is on helping customers integrate these products into their operations and supporting them over time through subscriptions, cloud services and technical support. That gives us opportunities to expand our relationship with customers after the initial deployment.”
About Sagtec Global Limited

is a Malaysia-headquartered AI technology company providing AI-asissted software solutions, enterprise technology platforms, and digital transformation services to businesses across Southeast Asia. The Company develops customizable enterprise software, intelligent data management platforms, and cloud-based technologies that support digital transformation across multiple industries.
